name: Quality Houses Public Company Limited
summary: Quality Houses Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the property development business in Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Real Estate Business, Hotel Business, Rental Business, and Others. It develops and sells land and houses and residential condominium units; rents office buildings; and provides services for residential buildings, as well as manages public utilities and real estate business of landowners. In addition, the company is involved in hotel operations; lease of land; and management of buildings. Quality Houses Public Company Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
